scope: source rule map and synthetic preflight only; NOT backtest completion
engine_runtime: research pin only; author original runtime unknown

parameter_precedence.special_flags: external runtime config > sidecar special values > class > engine/resolver defaults
parameter_precedence.parameter_objects: sidecar params > buy_params/sell_params with load=True > constructor defaults

account_semantics.collision: entry suppressed when same-side exit also1; signal exit requires not entry
account_semantics.exit_order_priority: signal exit, stop/liquidation, ROI, trailing stop; actual fills require pinned backtester/model
account_semantics.profit_only: applies to signal exits only; requires current_profit>exit_profit_offset; does not block ROI/stop
account_semantics.ROI: integer elapsed minutes, largest elapsed key, strict profit>threshold in interface; backtester may use favorable high for long
account_semantics.stop: initialized from trade.open_rate and stoploss; long low<=recorded_stop triggers in interface, actual fill semantics not proven by signal test
account_semantics.order_caveat: limit must not silently become guaranteed next-open market fill

execution_gate: pin config/sidecar presence and final effective attrs
fidelity HYPOTHESIS unless original runtime evidence exists
